subject: unstructured EHR data at scale
text:
Hi 
      [NAME],

      Parsing unstructured physician notes for patient matching is one of the harder NLP problems in healthcare AI. We're worked through it with Mayo Clinic and Iterative Health on similar EHR and document-heavy pipelines.  

      The issues that kept slowing them down: annotation workflows that didn't scale, inconsistent label quality across doc types, and no audit trail for regulatory review. 

      Encord solved all three - LLM-assisted pre-labeling, HITL QA, and full label versioning that holds up under FDA scrutiny. 

      Given where Topography is heading with WaypointsOS, I'd say at least one is already on your radar - worth a 20-min call to compare notes?
